title: Reflect Upon Yourself
description: Brings Terraria's Iconic Magic Mirror to Minecraft!
body:
# This mod adds the Magic Mirror to minecraft!



## Features
- Right-click to teleport back to your spawn location
- 15 second cooldown between uses
- Particles and sound effects!
- A Brand New Advancement as well
- Uh not much else, but it can be really useful!

I made this in one night and am really happy with it, I hope you enjoy what I made here and it's useful for your world or modpack! (May bring MORE Terraria items to minecraft..)
